# T-3: Display recorded failure

## Goal
Update prompt guidance, status/report data, and human-readable reports so failed-recorded final-regression is explicit and never appears as pass or skipped.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Prompt guidance includes first failure and repeated failure recommendation order.
- Auto mode guidance selects the recommended action.
- Report/status output includes selectedAction, category, raw log path, fix attempts, remaining risk, and next recommended action.

## Implementation Notes
Touch impl/final-regression prompt and report/status consumers only where they read final-regression artifacts. Keep source text generic for package distribution.

## Test Strategy
Static or unit tests for prompt/report text and report JSON shape.
